subject: Maths
title: Area & Perimeter Grid
goal: Draw a shape on a grid and find its area and perimeter by counting squares.
intro: Namaste {student_name}! Let's draw a shape and measure it.

steps.instruction: Tap squares on the grid to draw a closed shape.
steps.concept: A closed shape on a grid has an inside (area) and an outline (perimeter).

steps.instruction: Count how many whole squares are inside your shape.
steps.concept: Area is the number of unit squares that fit inside the shape.

steps.instruction: Count how many unit edges make up the boundary of your shape.
steps.concept: Perimeter is the total length of the boundary, measured in grid units.

checkpoints.question: What is the area of your shape in squares?
checkpoints.expected: the number of whole unit squares inside the shape
checkpoints.hint: Count only the squares fully inside your outline.

checkpoints.question: What is the perimeter of your shape?
checkpoints.expected: the total number of unit edges along the outer boundary
checkpoints.hint: Walk around the outside edge and count each unit step.
